learningObjectives: Explain how for and while loops repeat program instructions.
Construct loops using ranges, conditions, and iteration variables.
Apply break and continue to control loop execution.

activities.title: Loop Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a for loop.

content.concept: A for loop iterates over items in an iterable. The loop variable receives each item and the indented body executes for each iteration.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Starts the loop and assigns each value from the iterable to number.
The indented loop body executes once for each iteration.
Loop variable that receives the current value.

activities.title: Iteration Sequence
activities.instruction: Order the steps of a for-loop execution.

content.concept: A loop obtains the next value from its iterable, assigns it to the loop variable, executes the body, and continues until the iterable is exhausted.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 1. Get the next value from the iterable
2. Assign the value to the loop variable

activities.title: Loop Builder
activities.instruction: Build a loop that prints the numbers 1 through 5.

content.concept: range() can generate a sequence of numbers for a for loop. The stop value is excluded.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Loop Control Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify what break and continue do inside a loop.

content.concept: break terminates the loop immediately, while continue skips the remaining statements in the current iteration and proceeds to the next iteration.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: continue → skip to the next iteration
